correctness.rationale: The quotient group generators are transverse translations by a,b and the half-turn screw by h. Even screw powers give shortest pure-translation displacement min(a,2h). For odd powers the shortest based displacement is sqrt(h^2+dist(2x,aZ)^2+dist(2y,bZ)^2). Uniform-volume sampling makes the folded distances independent uniforms U,V on [0,a/2],[0,b/2], proving L^2=min(a^2,4h^2,h^2+U^2+V^2). Area integration of the quarter disk clipped to [0,a/2]x[0,b/2] proves the CDF including cap atom. Exact fourth moments yield Var(U^2+V^2)=(a^4+b^4)/180. Differentiating Var(min(Q,q)) gives 2 Pr(Q>q)(q-E min(Q,q))>0 on the interior support, and q(h)=min(3h^2,a^2-h^2) peaks at h=a/2. The equality plateau q>= (a^2+b^2)/4 exists iff b/a<=sqrt2, with the stated exact interval; h>=a makes variance zero.
